fork.name: openpilot
fork.description: The upstream commaai/openpilot project itself — the reference open-source driver-assistance system that all community forks derive from. Focus is on a validated, safety-reviewed core: lane centering on 300+ cars, alpha openpilot longitudinal control, end-to-end Experimental Mode, and camera-based driver monitoring, with no community convenience features (no MADS, VTSC, mapd, or nudgeless lane change).

features.name: Automated Lane Centering
features.description: Continuously steers to keep the car centered in its lane. Works on all supported cars; some models cannot steer below a minimum speed and some have limited steering torque for sharp curves.

features.name: openpilot Longitudinal Control
features.description: openpilot controls gas and brake instead of the car's stock adaptive cruise control. Standard on some cars; on many others it is alpha quality behind the 'openpilot Longitudinal Control (Alpha)' toggle, which is only available on non-release branches; on the rest the stock ACC is used.

features.name: Experimental Mode (end-to-end longitudinal)
features.description: Opt-in end-to-end driving mode where the model also decides speed: it can stop for red lights and stop signs, slow for curves and turns, and drive beyond chill mode. Requires openpilot longitudinal control on that car.

features.name: Driver Monitoring
features.description: Infrared driver camera watches head pose and eyes and warns, then disengages, if the driver is distracted or drowsy. Works on every car and cannot be disabled while engaged.

features.name: Stop and Go
features.description: Comes to a full stop behind traffic and automatically resumes. On some cars the driver must tap resume or the accelerator to move again, and a few cars cannot accelerate below a minimum ACC speed.

features.name: Lane Change Assist
features.description: With the turn signal on and a slight steering nudge, openpilot completes the lane change. Driver-initiated only — stock openpilot has no nudgeless/automatic lane change and does no blind spot checking.

features.name: Always-On Driver Monitoring
features.description: Opt-in toggle (AlwaysOnDM) that keeps driver monitoring active even when openpilot is not engaged.

features.name: Driving Personality
features.description: Aggressive / Standard / Relaxed setting (LongitudinalPersonality) that adjusts follow distance and acceleration behavior. Only affects driving when openpilot longitudinal control is active.

features.name: Lane Departure Warnings
features.description: Warns when the car drifts over a lane line above 31 mph without a turn signal, even when openpilot is not engaged. Can be toggled off.

features.name: Disengage on Accelerator toggle
features.description: Stock toggle controlling whether pressing the gas pedal disengages openpilot; with it off, openpilot stays engaged while the driver accelerates.

features.name: Driver Camera Recording
features.description: Opt-in toggle (RecordFront) to record and upload the driver-facing camera to improve driver monitoring.

features.name: Audio Recording
features.description: Opt-in toggle (RecordAudio) to record microphone audio with drives; a recent upstream addition.

features.name: Firehose Mode
features.description: Dedicated settings page that uploads all drive data at maximum rate to contribute training data to comma; works on any car and on WiFi.

features.name: comma connect / remote access
features.description: Cloud pairing via athena: drive review in comma connect, remote SSH tunneling, OTA updates, and upload management. Device-level, car-independent.

features.name: Lateral/Longitudinal Maneuver Testing
features.description: Developer modes (LateralManeuverMode / LongitudinalManeuverMode params) that run scripted control maneuvers for tuning and system identification; actively developed upstream (e.g. 'Improve lateral maneuvers' #38159).
